svg.desc: Ablation V1 FC2 training curves for the first 120 epochs. Metrics: Mean EPE and Sintel EPE.
svg.text: Ablation V1 FC2 Training Curves (First 120 Epochs)
Lower EPE is better. Curves use evaluation checkpoints only; learning rate is intentionally omitted.
Generated from eval_history.csv files in outputs/ablation_v1_fc2; only epochs <= 120 are plotted.
